history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man, silhouetted against a soft, hazy dawn sky, stands on a grassy incline, gazing out at a sea of clouds below. He wears a dark, high-necked sweater, his dark, tousled hair visible as he turns away from the viewer. In the background, a second, smaller figure is also silhouetted on the left, standing near a pine tree, adding a sense of scale and companionship to the vast landscape. The sky transitions from a pale blue at the top to warm hues of orange and yellow near the horizon, where the sun is just beginning to break through the misty layers. The foreground is dominated by dark, earthy tones of the hillside and the silhouettes of dry, leafy plants, creating a contrast with the ethereal cloudscape. The overall mood is one of peaceful solitude, contemplation, and awe at the natural beauty of the sunrise over the mountains. The lighting is soft and diffused, characteristic of early morning, casting a gentle glow and creating a painterly, almost dreamlike quality. The color palette is dominated by muted blues, soft oranges, warm yellows, and deep greens and browns. The style is realistic with a strong emphasis on atmospheric perspective and silhouette.
